incident-bot: PagerDuty auto-page fired for service routing-proxy-eu-west-1 — symptom: 5xx rate spike (>3%) over 60s. Severity: P2 auto. https://pd.example/incidents/INC12345

sophia: ack — seeing the page on my phone, jumping in

raj: oncall here, pulling traces and p95 graphs now

sophia: console: spike at 02:14 UTC. p95 latency +2.1s, error rate briefly ~3.6%. status page shows no public incidents

raj: quick logs: a burst of backend 503s correlated with KV cache miss storm, looks like a short-lived prewarm on a few hosts

raj: no deploys in window, autoscaler did spawn 2 extra instances then scaled down ~40s later

taylor: any synthetic canaries firing? I see a healthcheck loop from synthetic-eu that aligns with the window

raj: yeah that synthetic was noisy — it triggered a cascade of retries. I disabled it for eu-west for 5m as a quick mitigation: `./synthctl disable --id synthetic-eu --region eu-west --ttl 300`

sophia: nice. PD shows an auto-resolve at 02:15:21 UTC (about 47s). No customer-facing error reports in Sentry or support queue

raj: marking as no-customer-impact for now. Will follow up with autoscaler + synthetic tuning. Adding a short blameless note in incident tracker

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: incident INC12345 auto-resolved (duration 47s).

raj: handing off to next oncall (sophia -> raj) for postmortem draft. I'll create a quick action: suppress synthetic-eu if it re-fires within 10m and adjust synthetic cadence

sophia: thanks. I'll unpin when we have the postmortem link. :thumbsup:

taylor: thanks all — letting this thread fade, ping if it reappears
